subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + phased initial net-90 for Vanguard Consortium
messages:
From: Mina Desai <mina@akera.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vanguardconsortium.org>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly invoicing + phased net-90 ask for Vanguard Consortium

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Vanguard Consortium is excited to move forward but finance has a strict fiscal alignment across five member entities that makes monthly invoicing very difficult. They asked whether Redwood can: 1) invoice quarterly across the consortium (single consolidated invoice), and 2) provide a phased net-90 for the first two quarters (to ease cashflow across entities) before transitioning to standard Net-30 thereafter.

A few constraints from their side:
- They require consolidated invoicing (one invoice that covers the five entities).
- Treasury prefers payment timing aligned to quarter-ends (so billing issued on 6/30, 9/30, etc.).
- They may request an initial 60–90 day payment window for the pilot quarter only.

Can Redwood consider this structure at pilot scale? We can provide a signed SOW and are willing to set up ACH/PO details if needed.

Attachments: example internal approval note (they shared) — not attached here.

Best,
Mina Desai
Head of Strategic Accounts — Akera Systems
mina@akera.com
+1 (415) 555-0189
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Desai <mina@akera.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vanguardconsortium.org>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly invoicing + phased net-90 ask for Vanguard Consortium

Mina —

Appreciate the detail. We can potentially support quarterly, consolidated invoices and a temporary extended payment window, but this requires a short approval path from Deal Desk + Finance. Two immediate asks from my side so we can move quickly:

1) Please send the signed SOW (or confirm the SOW text) so we can attach to the payment amendment.
2) Can Vanguard provide a short credit contact and expected payment timing for the first two quarters (estimate: Q2 and Q3)?

Proposed mitigation from Redwood to reduce risk:
- 50% prepayment on the first consolidated invoice OR
- Escrow arrangement for the first invoice OR
- A modest onboarding holdback (we invoice quarterly but release service after first payment)

I'm looping in Monica (CS/Finance ops) and Markus (Sales leadership) to route for approval. Monica/Markus — can you confirm whether Finance will sign off on a pilot with conditional net-90 for the first two quarters and consolidated quarterly invoicing across multiple legal entities under a single invoicing umbrella? If approved, we'll prepare a short amendment (SOW addendum) and DocuSign link.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quarterly invoicing + phased net-90 ask for Vanguard Consortium

Monica / Markus — forwarding Vanguard request and Mina's note. TL;DR: consolidated quarterly invoice across five related entities + temporary net-90 for first two quarters (then Net-30).

Why I think this is strategic:
- Large consortium with multi-year potential (they sign annual SOW covering all entities).
- Reduces friction for deployment across public-sector partners they coordinate.
- They are willing to sign and provide ACH/PO info, and can provide a 50% prepay if required.

Specific approvals needed from Finance/Deal Desk:
- Approve consolidated invoice across five entities under a single corporate payer (Vanguard Consortium).
- Approve temporary net-90 for Q2 and Q3 only; revert to Net-30 after that.
- Approve SOW amendment template and minimal late-fee waive policy for first 60 days.

Risk mitigations proposed: 50% prepay OR escrow OR commit to an annual term with an 8% early-commit discount (negotiable).

Can you please: 1) confirm if Credit completes for this counterparty (if yes, can we get a short credit memo), and 2) if approved, mark any legal language Finance requires in the amendment?

I attached an internal draft payment plan (Quarterly_Payment_Plan.xlsx) and the signed SOW stub (Signed_SOW_v1.pdf) per Mina.

— Jonas
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quarterly invoicing + phased net-90 ask for Vanguard Consortium

Jonas / Monica —

I reviewed the account and had a quick call with Credit. Summary and conditions for approval:

1) Credit: provisional pass, contingent on Vanguard providing POs for the consolidated invoices and a banking reference — Credit will complete final review after first invoice is generated.
2) Payment terms: approve temporary net-90 for the first two quarterly invoices (Q2 and Q3) only.

Conditions we require before execution:
- 50% prepayment on the first consolidated invoice OR company places first quarter in escrow (Customer to choose).
- Legal to sign a short amendment that explicitly states: (a) pilot net-90 applies only to Q2/Q3; (b) standard Net-30 applies thereafter; (c) failure to meet payment milestone moves account to hold and standard late fees apply.
- No pricing concessions beyond a one-time onboarding credit of up to 5% of the first invoice. Larger discounts require Director approval.

If Monica signs off from ops side, I'm comfortable greenlighting this. Monica — please confirm you can operationalize consolidated billing across the five legal entities under a single invoice number and that AR can accept ACH referencing multiple POs.

Markus Klein
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Desai <mina@akera.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vanguardconsortium.org>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly invoicing + phased net-90 ask for Vanguard Consortium

Mina / Liam —

Thanks for your patience. We can proceed on the pilot with the following agreed path (conditional approval from Redwood):

- Billing cadence: consolidated quarterly invoice covering the five Vanguard entities (single invoice).
- Payment timing: temporary Net-90 for the first two quarterly invoices (Q2 and Q3). Net-30 resumes starting Q4.
- Risk mitigation: Vanguard to choose either 50% prepayment on the first consolidated invoice OR place the first quarter in escrow.
- One-time onboarding credit capped at 5% on the first invoice. No other pricing concessions approved.

Next steps:
1) We will prepare a short amendment and send via DocuSign (link below). Please review and sign.
2) Provide the POs and ACH/bank reference for Credit.
3) Decide on prepay vs escrow and confirm by EOD Apr 28 so we can meet a Q2 start.

DocuSign (amendment stub): https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABC12345
Attached: Quarterly_Payment_Plan.xlsx; Signed_SOW_v1.pdf (for reference).

If you agree, I'll route the amendment to legal and set the DocuSign flow to include the five entity billing contacts.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
